event: 校董会放弃并把这些学校与产业售回海外传道部
source: Canton Christian College, Its Field and Work in China (1908), p. 9 / PDF p. 12
note: 官方原文：“relinquished and resold... in 1898”

event: 发出征召三名基督教教育者的邀请；派出 Wisner（校长）、Woods、Lewis
people: Oscar F. Wisner;Andrew H. Woods;Clancey M. Lewis
source: Canton Christian College, Its Field and Work in China (1908), p. 9 / PDF p. 12
note: 征召年份原文未直写，紧接 1898 年叙述

event: 因中国局势动荡，学校迁往澳门（葡属，近香港）
